payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation for using word overlap (F1 score) instead of exact match when comparing entities, highlighting the need to account for different naming conventions for the same entity.

claims.text: Word overlap (F1 score) is used instead of exact match to account for different names referring to the same entity, avoiding false positives in detecting invalid questions.
Using F1 allows for the identification of entities that may be mentioned differently in predictions compared to gold answers, which is crucial for accurate evaluation.
